title: Jump to the Sixth
setup: Black has just lifted a rook to c6, while its king hides behind three pawns with a rook on f8.
hint: One knight square touches the king's corner and the sixth rank at once, and your rook already guards it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ne7+}} forks the king and the rook on c6, and the rook on e1 defends the knight, so nothing can take it. Black's own rook fills f8, so {{Kh8}} is the only move, and {{Nxc6}} wins a whole rook.
